title: Orientation & Introductions
details: Day 1: Explored the labs and machineries, got introduced to the staffs and fellow students, and played a brain-intensive game.
Day 2: Divided into teams to analyze a case study and answer technical questions, followed by a detailed introduction to the 20-week program and past works.
Day 3: Browsed through ZenPencils comics and did a presentation on a comic we could relate to ourselves.
Day 4: Team-building activity - built a spaghetti stick base to balance a marshmallow on top.

title: Foundations
details: Day 1-3: Followed and implemented the principles of 5S.
Day 4-5: Worked on building this portfolio website and hosting it on Vercel.
